stem: What does a higher atmospheric VPD represent most directly?
choices: A larger vapor-pressure difference that increases atmospheric evaporative demand
A guaranteed diagnosis of root-zone drought
A direct measurement of nutrient concentration
A measure of the number of light photons reaching the canopy
rationale: VPD describes atmospheric drying demand through a vapor-pressure difference. It is not by itself a measurement of root-zone water content or nutrition.

purposeCorrection.reason: Item is used only in a formative shared-foundation module checkpoint and is not referenced by any summative or credential assessment.
